tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// tā'i si tu pad+ma'i ljags ldan dang po rje pad+ma nyin byed dbang po'i bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag yid 'phrog bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru mañdzu shri ye/ pa~Xd+ma~X'i 'dab ltar yangs pa'i spyan ras dang*// lhan cig rang byung ye shes gzigs pa yi// dge mtshan nyi~Xn bye~Xd bye ba'i dpal 'bar ba// srid zhi'i rnam 'dren dba~Xng po~X gang der 'dud// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i mnga' thang la// bzang po spyod pa'i rnam thar rgya mtsho yis// rtag gnas don kun grub pa'i brtul zhugs ni// lhun gyis grub pa khyod 'dra srid na dkon// de phyir gdod nas dang po'i sangs rgyas dang*// gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid chen po ste// 'di na bde gshegs bye ba phrag brgya yi// spyi gzugs nyid du nges pa cis mi rnyed// dad dang gus pas bsnyen rnams lta ci smos// skad cig yid mkhar shar bas kyang mchog dngos// bde blag nyid 'grub des na skal bzang gi /'gro ba phyi mthar thug pa'ang 'gog tu ci// gang dang gang la phan bde khyad par can// srid mtha'i bar du ster slad don che ba// gang gsung chos 'khor slar la 'dod 'jo'i sprin// mi zad dbyig tu deng dus 'char 'di rmad// thams cad mkhyen gzigs tā'i si tu zhes pa'i skye phreng rnams rgyal dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug mchog dang ngo bo thugs rgyud dbye ba med par zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar la rnam pa thugs sras kyi thu bo'i tshul bzung nas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad pa'i bdag nyid can te dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i skabs si tu 'gro mgon ras chen nas bzung deng bar nyi ma dang zer bzhin skye ba'i phreng ba lhan cig tu rgyun mi chad pa bstar ba rnams 'phags chen kho na'i rnam thar bri gang dang bral ba 'dzin pa sha stag mu tig bstar la brgyus pa dang 'dra ba tshar du dngar ba'i phul du byon pa byung zhing*/ lhag par sangs rgyas karma pa'i phrin las 'dzin pa la thugs bskyed dang smon lam khyad par 'phags pa lta bus thugs sras rgya mtsho'i nang nas gsang gsum mdzad rlabs dang bcas pa gang ci'i thad si tu'i skyes rabs rnams dang mnyam pa 'ga' yang ma byung ba 'dra ste/

si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis rgyal dbang lnga pa rgya nas yar phebs karma'i dgon du bzhugs skabs ston 'khor khri tsho mang por yun ring zhabs tog bsnyen bkur 'dod 'jo'i char bzhin zhus pa tsam kho na yang gzhan su la'ang byung skad mi 'dug pa sogs kyis mtshon no// si tu bkra shis dpal 'byor nyid rgyal dbang chos grags rgya mtsho rang gi sprul sku yin par zhal gyis bzhes pas mtshon rgyal dbang rim can nas rtogs pa don gyi thugs rgyud dbye ba med pa'i dgongs bzhes thog /mthong grol pad+ma rā ga'i cod pan dbur bcings pa nas bzung si tu'i sku phreng rnams rgyal dbang rnams dang gdan gcig dang*/ bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rjes kun mkhyen chos 'byung la 'ja' sa dang shel tham gnang pa sogs zhwa dmar gyi mtshan gnyis pa 'dra mnyam du byung ba lta bu ni/ phyis zhwa dmar dngos sku skye'i spros par dgongs gtad mi mdzad pa'i rjes su zhwa dmar pa'i rgyal tshab tu don gyis mnga' gsol ba'i rten 'byung gi gnad du yin par mngon te/ deng sang zhwa dmar nag gnyis zhes mtshan lhur len yongs su grags pa ltar ro// gang ltar yang gdan sa bar ma'i 'du khang chen mo'i sbug tu bzhugs khri rnying pa mdun phyogs bstan la bltas na mtho dman an tsam las mi 'dug pa sngar nas yab sras gsum po thob thang mnyam nyid du mdzad srol yod pa 'dra'o// chos kyi 'byung gnas bar karma dgon gyi bstan bdag tu bsko bzhag mdzad don ltar bzhugs pa sha stag dang*/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan snga ma la 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos las lung gi gzengs bstod mtshan gsol gnang ba nas/ tā'i si tu zhes pa'i mtshan chags pa yin 'dug cing*/ de nas bzung si tu zhes pa'i skye phreng bsgrangs pa'i si tu brgyad pa kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas ni 'khrungs yul gyi dbang gis me tog phog pa'i lha skal zhes gdan sar bslur ma btang bar dbang shugs kyis chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring zhes grags pa'am/

rgyal bas/ chu bo gser ldan 'bab pa'i 'gram// rgyal po byis pa'i ming can 'byung*// zhes lung bstan pa'i lung don dang mthun par ming bla dwags bu zhes 'bod pa de nyid kyis bdag bzung mdzad thog dgung lo nyer brgyad dus dpal spungs dgon zhes pa'i lha khang dang 'brel ba'i chos sde gsar du bskrun nas dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ yul 'brog gnyis char nas grwa rtsa rnams dang rnam dkar mchod thebs rtsa ba sa zhing sde 'khor sogs shin tu rgya che phul sbyor steng gdan sa 'dir bzhugs su gsol ba sogs kyi mthun rkyen bla med du mdzad pas bka' brgyud bstan pa'i don du sngon smon gyis mtshams sbyar ba'i mchod yon thun min gyi rten 'brel legs 'grigs su gyur cing*/ de yi sras bla chen phun tshogs bstan pa nas lhag par dar rgyas su btang ba yin 'dug pas gtsos sde dge sa dbang rim byon nas zhabs 'degs sri zhu gang smar rgyun bsrings deng sang bar byung dang 'byung bzhin pa bcas/ dpal spungs dgon zhes rgya bod hor sog gi ljongs rnams yongs su grags pa kar dgon kun gyi 'chel sa bshad sgrub kyi chos sde chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba 'di byung ngo*// 'di nyid sprul pa'i skyes chen 'gran zla kun bral yin rgyu'i yon tan ngo mtshar ba rnams ni thun mong snang ngo la'ang sku btsas ma thag pa nas 'phags mchog dngos dang mtshungs pa byis pa'i spyod yul las 'das pa phal cher lhan skyes su mnga' ba'i tshul bstan mdzad pa sogs rnam thar gzhan du yongs grags ltar las ma mchis shing*// 'phags yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta'i bag chags thugs la sad pa lta bus legs sbyar gyi gzhung la rang stobs kyis lhag par mnga' dbang 'byor zhing*/ rgya gar pa'i phal skad rnams sngon gnas rjes dran du byung gsungs 'dug pa ltar dang bcas chos bsgyur ba la paṇ+ḍi ta dang lo tsā gnyis 'dzoms mi dgos par rang stobs kyis gtsang zhing dag par bsgyur ba dang*/

sngar bsgyur rigs 'gyur bcos mdzad pa sogs la gzhig na sngon byon lo tsā mang po byon rigs phal che bas 'gran du med par ris med mkhas grub yongs kyis mgrin gcig ched du brjod pa ltar ro// rgyal mchog bcu gnyis pa dang*/ khyad par bcu gsum bdud 'dul rdo rje'i rigs bdag gcig pur gyur cing*/ kar bstan la 'pho 'gyur cung byung ba'i skabs/ 'phags yul ba'i mkhas pa sgo drug sogs dang 'dra ba'i mtshan dang snyan grags nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon rnams su rlung ltar rgyu bas rgya bod sog gsum sogs kyi ljongs kun tu bla chen dpon chen che rgu kun gyi dbus mchog dman ser skya mtha' dag rnam thar yon tan gyi che bas dad gus kyi lam du dbang bsgyur du byung ba nyag gcig la brten/ thabs mkhas thugs rje gzhan dring mi 'jog pas mtshams sbyar nas/ karma kaṃ tshang gi bstan pa'i me ro rmang nas gso ba'i phyag rjes 'gran zla dang bral bas na snying po'i bstan pa la bka' drin shin tu che bar gyur pa ste/ bla slob nang ma'i bka' 'gros thog kaṃ tshang ston bstan kho na'i ched du nam snying rnam 'phrul rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu zhal tshab tu dbus phyogs su phebs te sku tshe ril por rgyun bzhugs mdzad nas mkhas grub kyi gzi brjid me ltar 'bar bas bod khams kun dbang du bsdus nas gong bkur mchod 'os su byung skabs kar bstan la zhabs 'degs shin tu gong legs steng*/ mthing dmar cod pan 'chang ba sbug mjal nam byung skabs gong sa lha mi'i gtsug rgyan chen po gser khri las bzhengs te thang shad kyi phyag len tsam gnang rgyu'i gzigs bzos gzengs bstod rgyun 'jags su thob byung bas yab sras zung gi bstan srid la sri zhu ni phyogs las rnam rgyal gyur song ngo zhes rig 'dzin de nyid kyis rje chos 'byung la gnang ba'i gsung phrin phyag bris ngo ma mig mthong du byung ba sogs kyis kyang du ba'i rtags kyis me bzhin rgyu mtshan mtshon nus so// spyir si tu'i sku phreng rnams byams pa mgon po'i rnam 'phrul ni yongs grags ltar la/

'phags yul gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug ḍom+bhi he ru ka /bod yul du mar pa lo tsā sogs dang*/ dgongs 'dus bka' rgya ma las/ o rgyan chen po pad+ma'i rnam rol chos kyi spyan can drug dang*/ pad+ma'i ljags ldan drug 'brel chags su 'byung ba lung du bstan pa dang*/ dmigs bsal rje 'di rang nyid kyi sngon gnas rjes dran lta bu 'ga' zhig /shrī sidha/ lo tsā ba 'dan ma rtse mang*/ spang mkhan chen 'od zer bla ma sogs gsal bar byung 'dug cing*/ gzhan yang yongs dge mi 'gyur rdo rjes/ sa skya paṇa chen/ bo dong 'jigs bral/ jo nang rje btsun/ rngog lo chen po/ rje tsong kha pa sogs kyi sku skye yin tshul yang yang zhal nas gsungs pa dang*/ dbus nas rgya nag tu 'gro ba'i mkhan nang zhig bud med sogs kyis ja chang gis skyel nas bzhad 'then gyis gshar yong ba dang 'phrad nas bzhad kyi glu rta 'di gdangs zhig la sbyar na rung ngo snyam nas gro lod spyan 'dren sogs la sbyar dgos dgongs te thugs la gsal 'debs skabs nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang ba'i gro lod kyi sku che phra du ma'i zhal gzigs/ mtshur phu gung gi ri khrod du sgrol dkar ljags bsnyen mdzad skabs sgrol dkar gyi zhal gzigs/ dpal spungs dgu gtor gyi gral dbur byon nas mgon po'i gdan 'bul skabs shig mgon po ber nag gsal bar mjal rgyu dang dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku gzugs shin tu che ba gsal bar mjal rgyu byung 'dug pa sogs ni cha shas tsam mo// tsā ri rtse skor la phebs dus sa rdo ri brag sogs yul khams dang der yod mi thams cad stong gzugs 'ja' 'od kyi rang bzhin du gzigs/ dbu ma sogs gsan bsam khong nas rgyud bla gsan nub 'phags pa thogs med yin snyam pa'i lha'i rnam pa zhig gsal bar mjal ba'i nyams snang byung ba la brten/ dgon 'di la sa la spyod pa'i dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin zhes ba'i ming du btags pa yin gsungs 'dug

/bla ma'i gtso bo zhwa dmar brgyad pa/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu sogs dang*/ slob ma'i gtso bo rgyal dbang bcu gnyis pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa/ zhwa dmar bcu pa/ rig 'dzin chen po dang*/ kar 'brug yongs rdzogs kyi bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu yod do cog dang*/ sa dge rnying sogs kyi bstan 'dzin dge bshes dpag tu med pa rnams so// sbyin bdag gi gtso bo lung nas zin rigs mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal/ sde dge bsod nams mgon po/ chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring*/ chos rgyal shākya rgyal mtshan sku mched yab sras rnams dang*/ rdo stod smad kyi dpon la sogs pa'o/// / ༈ chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi sprul pa'i sku de ma thag pa si tu dgu pa rje pad+ma nyin byed dbang po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ rnam thar gsol 'debs tshigs bcad lo chen gyis mdzad pa zhig dang*/ 'jam mgon rin po ches gter brgya'i rnam thar gras su sa bon tsam smos pa ltar las/ zhib tu yi ger bkod pa sogs gang yang mjal rgyu mi 'dug /'di nyid karma pa/ zhwa dmar/ dpa' bo gsum gyis ngos 'dzin mdzad/ khyad par dpa' bos/ slob dpon pad 'byung chos dbyings ye shes kyi klong du mjal nas/ sbra sgo shar du bstan cing*// longs spyod 'grang ltogs snyoms par// byis pa shing rta lo pa// mgrin rtsa dung dkar dbyibs 'dra// lte ltag sme ba dmar nag /brla g.yas stag ris yod de// 'phags pa'i sa la bzhugs pa'i// byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i// rnam 'phrul chos kyi 'byung gnas// 'khrul med sprul sku nyid do// zhes lung bstan pa dang rje gong ma'i zhal che mas dang yang mthun par yid lhung 'brog sde'i nang du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te 'khrungs/ zhwa dmar chos 'grub rgya mtshos khri 'don sogs gnang*/ dgongs 'dus lung byang chos 'byung yan chos kyi spyan can drug rdzogs nas/

rje 'di nyid pad+ma'i ljags ldan dang por nges pas pad+ma dbang chen zhes pa'i mtshan dang dpa' bos kyang dag snang du de bzhin gsal ba ltar/ dpal ldan 'gyur med bstan 'dzin phyogs las rnam grol pad+ma nyin byed dbang po'i sde zhes pa'i mtshan gyi cod pan bcings*/ gter chen bdud 'dul ba'i ma 'ongs spyi lung du/ yid lhung phyogs nas pad+ma'i ming can 'byung : zhes pa'i ming dang shugs kyis 'grigs par gyur/ rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa las rab byung gsan skabs/ dpal ldan bstan 'dzin nyin byed phrin las kun khyab phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes pa'i mtshan gnang*/ rgyal ba de nyid dang*/ zhwa dmar chos 'grub rgya mtsho/ 'brug chen kun gzigs chos kyi snang ba/ gar dbang chos skyong 'gyur med/ 'dzi sgar bka' brgyud phrin las rnam rgyal sogs bla mar bsten cing*/ gtso bor rje bdud 'dul rdo rje rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ de rnams las bka' brgyud kaṃ tshang gi smin grol yan lag dang bcas pa'i rgyun ci mchis dang*/ 'bri 'brug stag lung shangs pa zhi byed bka' gdams skor/ rnying ma bka' gter gyi chos rgyun phal che ba sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi chos lugs kun la gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad/ khyad par sdom pa gsum gyi bcas khrims phra mo tsam las kyang nam yang mi 'da' ba'i sku btsun pa'i mchog tu gyur/ skyes thob kyi yon tan 'bad med du sad pa'i dbang gis rig gnas skor dang*/ lhag par mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs kun la mkhyen pa rgyas pas mkhas pa'i phul du son/ gzhan yang rgya dkar nag gi yig ris/ sku brnyan gyi bri bkod/ gsar rnying rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i phyag len gar thig dbyangs rol sogs shes bya che phra mtha' dag rang bzhin gyis ma mkhyen pa gang yang med pa ngo mtshar ba'i gnas dang*/ sgom byung gi shes rab klong nas brdol bas 'chad rtsom rigs la 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa thob/

mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud grol bas rdo rje'i mgur ma thol byung du blangs pa rnams lhag par ngo mtshar che/ bstan 'gro'i don la gcig tu gzhol ba'i thugs bskyed rlabs chen du mnga' bas bzang po'i phrin las mkha' khyab tu brdal/ karma pa bcu gsum pas nges don snying po'i bstan pa gtad/ bcu bzhi pa'i rigs bdag gcig pur phebs/ dbus phyogs su lan gsum bzhud/ gzhi byes kun tu phyogs 'dus bgrang du mi langs pa la/ rtag par chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor bas dus 'da' bar mdzad/ stod mnga' ris nas 'jang rgya mtshams yan/ rdo sog tshun bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa gang mchis nyams pa sor chud/ ma nyams gong 'phel thog /dgon sde gsar bskrun 'ga' zhig dang*/ de dag rnams su dbang lung khrid gsum sogs smin grol chos kyi char pa phab cing*/ blang dor bcas khrims kyi rim pa las nam yang 'da' ba med pa'i bca' bkod gtsang btsan bstar/ mchod rgyun dang sgrub rgyun brgya phrag mang po btsugs/ sku gsung thugs gsum/ mchod chas yo byad skor sogs bgrang yas spus khyad gya nom ldan pa bstan dgon che chung gi babs dang bstun pa'i rten bzhag shin tu rgya cher gnang bas ma them pa su'ang med pa lta bu mngon sum du grub pa ltar dang*/ snga phyir dngul 'gyed spom mtho kho na lan gsum sogs lan mang gnang bas mtshon/ rten bzhag sogs mdzad tshul bka' 'bum nang tho tsam 'di res 'ga' ba zhig stes dbang gis yi ger 'khod pa ma gtogs de las rgya che ba phal cher mngon sum mthong chos su gsal rung mtha' dag yig ris su bkod rgyu'i spros pa ched gtad mdzad srol med 'dra ste mdor na blo yi rwa ba las 'das pa lta bu'o// spyir rgyun du rten bzhengs rgya che khor mo yug tu mdzad rigs rnams kar dgon brgya dang brgyad cu zhes grags pa'i dgon khag la sogs pa rnams su ched du gnang rgyu'i spros pa las gdan sa 'dir dgos 'os gal che 'ga' zhig las dmigs bsal rgya cher mdzad pa'i bzhed srol med pa lta bur grub bo// des na phyi dus bstan pa nyams dman skabs bka' brgyud bstan pa sngar yod rnams phyogs gang du yang nyi ma nub rir ma phyogs tsam byung ba 'di si tu gong 'og gi bka' drin thugs rje kho na la rag las pa ste/

de lta bu rgyu mtshan du byas nas dpal spungs dgon 'di bka' brgyud bstan pa rgya mtsho'i chu mgo gnyis pa khyad 'phags nyid du gyur to zhes grags pa don la gnas pa nyid do// gtso bor dus dang rgyun du zab mo'i rnal 'byor kho na la gzhol zhing*/ nyams bzhes kyi gtso bo bde phag /rgyal rgyam/ dkon spyi sogs dang*/ khyad par yi dam snying po sgrol dkar la mdzad/ blo sbyong*/ chos drug /phyag chen/ rdzogs chen khregs thod sogs la rtag tu brtson cing bskyed rdzogs kyi ting 'dzin mthar phyin pa'i sgo nas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa ste/ dbang rab kyi 'bring tsam gyi tshul bstan/ thun bzhi bcad khrigs nam yang thang lhod med cing*/ mtshan mor yang cung zad re mnal ba las phal cher gnyid spang gi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa sogs gdod nas sangs rgyas kyang lam sbyong ba'i tshul ston gyi rim pa yang dpe las 'das pa'i thugs brtson gnang zhing*/ phyis su rjes 'jug gdul bya rnams mig ltos 'dren slad dgung lo re gcig nas brgyad cu'i bar sgrub khang chen mor them pa mi 'da' ba'i spong ba bsam gtan gyi 'khor lor rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa nyid do// rnam kun gsol 'debs rjes dran gyi yul ni bla ma kun 'dus o rgyan rin po che kho na yin par snang ste/ rje bcu gsum pas/ pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs rje'i stobs chen po// mchog gi sprul sku pad+ma nyin byed zhabs// zhes o rgyan chen po'i sprul pa dngos yin rgyur gsungs pa'i bag chags thugs la 'khyil ba'i nyer len gyi dbang du gyur pas so// thugs sras kyi gtso bo ni dpal karma pa theg mchog rdo rje/ 'brug chen rin po che/ dpa' bo gtsug lag chos rgyal/ tre ho sogs kar 'brug gi skyes chen mtha' yas rnams dang*/ nang thugs kyi sras zla bzang nges don bstan pa rab rgyas/ khyad par du rgyal bas lung bstan dzam gling chos kyi shing rta 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che yon tan rgya mtsho gnyis yin la/

de mtshungs kun gzigs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la phyag chen chos drug sogs smin grol ci rigs pa gnang*/ thugs gtad shin tu che/ don brgyud byin gyis brlabs par zhal gyis bzhes/ thugs sras kyi mchog tu gyur/ gter rnying skor 'chad spel dang*/ phyogs bsdu byung na legs tshul bka' phebs pa'ang rin gter chen mo'i lung bstan don gyis gnang ba mthar phyin mngon du gyur pa 'di ltar yin 'jam mgon rin po ches gsungs/ gzhan yang rnying phyogs kyi bstan 'dzin rnams dang*/ rang dgon dbon sprul gong 'og rnams dang*/ dpal yul karma 'gyur med sogs shin tu mang ngo*// grub pa'i yon tan ni/ te lo nā ro/ mar mi dwags gsum sogs dang mnyam yang dgongs gzhi dgos pa'i dbang gis bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes rnams kyi rnam thar lhur len mdzad stabs rang gi yon tan bum nang gi mar me ltar sbed cing gsang ba srung ba la thugs shin tu sgam pas phyi nang sus kyang phra mo tsam yang gting mi dpog /skabs 'gar rab gnas zang thal du phebs shing*/ rdo la zhabs rjes/ zhabs sa la mi reg pa sogs dang*/ chu rdo nag po la a dkar 'bur du dod pa rdzu 'phrul gyis rang byon du brkos pa zhig da lta sgrub khang gi rten sgam du mjal rgyu yod pa sogs thun mong gi spyod yul du de 'dra 'ga' zhig bstan/ lhag par gzhan sems mkhyen pa sogs zag med kyi mngon shes ni sangs rgyas lta bu mnyam rjes dbye ba med par rgyun ldan mnga' ba yongs su grags shing*/ sprul sku ngos 'dzin gnang rigs rnams kyang 'khrul pa dang bral ba bstan pa la phan thogs pa'i yon tan khyad 'phags dang ldan pa sha stag byung ngo*// nges don snying po'i bstan pa karma pa bcu bzhi dang*/ 'jam mgon bla ma zung la gtad/ bgrang bya brgyad cur phebs pa na gzhan don du gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdu ba'i tshul bstan pa'i skabs/ 'di ltar/

nam mkha' sprin dang rlung ser rdul tsam med pa'i g.ya' dag /sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin la gnas pa'i rtags su yangs pa'i sa chen rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ sku spur bzhugs gdan la ma reg par zhag bdun phrag lnga'i bar du bar snang la ting nge 'dzin du bzhugs shing*/ spur sbyong ba'i dus rjes 'jug slob tshogs dang*/ 'jig rten lha mi kun gyi phyag mchod rten du dbu bum ril du byon cing*/ de la gu ru rin po che'i snang brnyan za hor lugs 'bur du dod pa/ lugs su blugs pa lta bu rang byon du phebs pa sogs ngo mtshar du ma mnga' ba'i 'phags chen dam pa nyid do zhes 'jam mgon rin po ches yi ger bkod pa'i phyag bris ngo ma mjal du byung ba sogs ya mtshan mtha' yas pa lags so// rje 'di nyid kyi gcung dpa' bo brgyad pa ste/ zab gter sogs kyi bka' babs shing dam pa'i skyes bu 'gran zla bral ba zhig bzhugs par grags so/// / ༈ rje pad+ma nyin byed dbang po'i sku skye si tu bcu pa pad+ma kun bzang chos kyi rgyal po de nyid ni rje nyid zhing gzhan du phebs khar thugs sras rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen du yang srid myur du 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes/ de rgyal dbang rin po cher zhus dang the tshom dang bral bar thag chod pa 'byung ngo zhes gsungs pa ltar bcu bzhi pa theg mchog rdo rjes zag bral ye shes kyi gzigs par sku 'khrungs pa'i yul dang sbra khyim yab yum gyi mtshan dgung snying rigs rus bcas sa ler shar ba rang byung rdo rje'i mgur ma tshigs su bcad pa mang pos lung bstan pa nges gsal som nyi dang bral ba ni byang gnam mtsho khar shing phag lor 'khrungs 'dug pa nges rnyed gyur te thugs thag bcad nas ngos 'dzin mdzad/ dus gsum sgrib bral du mkhyen cing sngon gnas rjes dran sogs ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan du ma mnga'/ gter chen mchog gling gi yel phug nam mkha' mdzod kyi chos sde las kyang*/

thang gi lha la gnam gyi mtsho yod par// nga yi sprul pa sa man+ta bha dra// shing phag lo la 'gro ba'i don byed 'byung*// zhes sogs kyi lung byang dang yang ji lta ba bzhin du 'grigs par gyur nas kun kyang yid ches kyi phul du gyur/ rje nyid sku gshegs khar thang lha'i zhal thang nub nas shar du yong pa zhig bri dgos gsungs nas bri rgyu mdzad pa'ang 'di lta'i rten 'brel gyi brda ston yin par gsungs/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che ston 'khor mtshur phur gdan zhus su ched phebs thog rim par dpal spungs dgon du spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig /karma pa chen pos khri khar mnga' gsol/ sku chung ngu'i dus nas mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ston pa la thogs pa med/ rgyal dbang rin po che'i mdun nas rab byung bsnyen rdzogs gsan/ rnam kun sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ mkhan chen bla ma bkra shis 'od zer yongs 'dzin du bsten nas bod brda sum rtags sogs dang gzhung lugs 'ga' re gsan/ karma pa'i mdun nas don brgyud kyi man ngag snying por dril ba rnams dang*/ 'jam mgon rin po che'i mdun nas bka' brgyud sngags mdzod/ rin chen gter mdzod sogs shin tu rgya chen dang*/ kun gzigs mkhyen brtse'i mdun nas de bzhin dbang lung khrid sogs mang du gsan/ rigs bdag gi bla ma mang du bsten kyang*/ gtso bor karma pa dang 'jam mgon rnam gnyis rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ dgon 'di'i tshogs sgo sngar yod dang*/ gsar spros kyi rim pa/ bca' khrims/ sgrig lam skor yar 'phel tshags tshud khor mo yug tu dpe zla bral par mdzad/ gzhan khams bod kyi dgon lag mtha' dag rnams lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas gzigs rtog nyams skyong*/ nyams gso'i thebs rtsa/ phan cha sbyin sgo sogs bstan pa nyams med yar dar yong ba'i thugs khur zab pa kho na la rtse gcig rgyun brtson gnang*/ dbus phyogs su lan kha shas phebs/

gter kha gsar rnying snga phyi du ma nas pad+ma'i snying po zhes lung du bstan cing*/ pad+ma'i ljags ldan gnyis par son/ thugs rje yas sprul gyi bdag nyid o rgyan chen po sku sha rlon pa dngos su grub bo zhes kun gzigs mkhyen brtses dus rgyun dad 'dun bsngags brjod gnang ba ltar/ dus gsum sa ler gzigs pa las nam yang g.yo ba mi mnga'/ lkog gyur dang*/ ma 'ongs pa lung du bstan rigs thams cad thog tu ma khel ba gcig kyang med pas kun gyis yid ches tshad mar 'dzin par gyur/ sku shin tu chung ngu'i dus bla brang du bzhugs yod pa'i nyin gung zhig la ri khrod rgyab ri'i phyogs nas 'jam mgon rin po che byon pa chib brdab phog pa de 'phral du mkhyen nas skrag dngangs shor te skyabs gsol mdzad pa de nyin khong la bar chad che ba zhig yod 'dug pa skyabs mgon rin po ches bsal ba yin 'dug /gzhan dang mi 'dra tshul phyis kyang rgyun ldan gsung srol yod dar bshad rgyu 'dug /tshur mthong grub pa chen po'i brtul zhugs 'chang ba'i tshul 'dzin pas/ snang sems ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i rtags gdan sa 'di dang*/ rang gtogs dgon khag phyogs dang sa yul gang dang gang du gshegs pa na sra mkhregs rdo la phyag zhabs kyi rjes 'dam bu'i tshal du glang po'i rjes bzhin bzhag pa mang zhing*/ khyad par byang kha rdza rgyud kyi sa char rdo leb sra mkhregs shin tu chen po zhig gi steng du zhabs rjes dang*/ chibs pa'i rjes re zung zab la gsal ba khyad mtshar zhig bzhag pa deng sang mjal rgyu yod/ phyogs de'i gzhi bdag nag phyogs pa zhig dam la btags pa'i ched du yin par grags/ phyis su rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chen po bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje de gzigs sa ched du phebs pa na gzhan mtshungs med pa'i rjes rnams dang*/ khyad par chibs pa'i rjes 'di 'dra shin tu dka' bas ngo mtshar mchog tu che ste o rgyan rin po che dngos yin 'dug ces thugs yid 'phrog pa'i gsung dngos su thos tshul grwa slob 'ga' zhig gi kha nas bshad rgyu 'dug

/'dan khogs phyogs nas 'bri chu chen mor chibs bcibs pa dang bcas sku stod man nub tsam thol byung gis brgal bas pha rir zin khar rta dang sku lus na bza' la chu yi zil pa tsam yang gos mi 'dug pa mngon sum mthong zhes phyogs der yod pa rnams kyis gleng rgyu byung ba sogs 'bri chu la zang thal du gshegs pa lan kha shas dang*/ bod du phebs lam chu chen rgyal mo dngul chu dbyar chu rgyas pas grus kyang brgal du bya thabs med dus/ rta drel ston 'khor tshang ma tsham tshom med par drag rtsal gyis gshegs rgyur mdzad byung bas chu rkang pa nub tsam las ma mthong ngos phar kar bde blag tu 'byor song zhes grwa tshang du song ba'i grwa rgan 'ga' yi ngag nas dngos su thos/ nyin gcig 'bral spang ber nag sku brnyan mdun rang phyogs kyi bstan dang bstan 'dzin la skyob srung med khar bstan dgra mi sgrol bar don med zhal gdangs mche gtsigs su bzhugs pa ci 'dra yin zhes bka' bkyon lta bur mdzad song bas de nyin rgyal rong shu bham dgon pa'i bstan pa la phan thogs dpe zla bral ba can khro chu rgyal po'i sras bla ma nyid dgon par gzigs rtog phyogs lhung che bar ma bzod nas spun ya dpon skya nag phyogs can nas nang dme byas te bsad song ba yin rgyu dang*/ kho rang yang de 'phral du rkyen lam song ba yin tshul sogs kyi gleng gzhi bcas/ spyir gar byon thams cad du rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston rgyu dang*/ dgos pa'i dus mngon shes lung bstan thogs med du ston pa sogs kyi lo rgyus ngo mtshar ba rgyus yod bla rgan rnams nas 'byams klas bshad rgyu 'dug kyang brjed thor ma 'khod pa sogs kyis 'dir ji bzhin bri ba rngo ma thogs/ 'jang dang*/ rgyal rong*/ rdo sogs dgon lag 'ga' rer rab gnas zla lam tsam rer zang thal du song ba dang*/ spu bo shul rdzong dgon du rab gnas kyi me tog 'di nas 'thor ba lha khang nang du kha ba bzhin babs byung ba kho na tshur bsdus pa da lta 'dang brgyad dgu tsam longs pa nang rten du bzhag 'dug zer/

mtha' yi dgon lag rigs grwa rgod rnams rang mos byung rgyal gyi spyod pa dang*/ dgon yul sde gang sa nas khrims med ngan pa lang shor byung rigs rnams rdzu 'phrul gyis spa bkong ba dang*/ sman dpyad kyis kyang bcos rgyu med pa'i pho skran rigs kyis gtsos/ nad gdon bgegs rigs rnams 'ga' zhig gsang chab kha la song ba sogs kyis rtsad nas 'joms pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig phyag 'bebs dang zhabs dbang tsam gyis 'joms pa sogs mang du byung ba kun la yongs grags ltar dang*/ nad pa tshe zad shi la khad pa 'ga' thugs gtad tsam gyis tshe ring du bsring ba sogs de dang de 'dra ba'i lo rgyus shin tu mang*/ lha gdan du/ ma da nas bkang ba'i dkar yol gyi kha sman khug bzhin du bsdus nas bal po'i tshong pa zhig la g.yang rten du gnang ba/ phyis snod bcud gnyis ka ma nyams pa dngos su mthong zhes khams pa'i tshong dpon zhig gi kha nas lab pa thos/ rtsa gsum lha yi zhal gzigs dang*/ khyad par srung ma'i gtso bo ber nag po can 'khor bcas lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs pas mtshon rang bstan srung ma rgya mtshos ci bcol bka' bzhin bsgrub pa dang*/ na bza' phyag mdud tsam 'chang ba rnams pha rol dgra sogs kyi mtshon cha lus la mi thebs shing*/ nad gdon bgegs bar sogs kyis mi tshugs pa de 'dra mngon sum mthong chos su gyur pa bgrang las 'das so// slob ma'i tshogs bka' brgyud bstan 'dzin che gras rnams te/ sku tshe cher ma bzhes stabs yongs grags mang tshan yod par ma mngon no// phyi dus kyi grub thob chen po bh+yo rig 'dzin sprul bsgyur gyis dga' ldan du phebs pas byams pa'i mdun sku zhabs si tu phebs 'ong rgyu'i 'ur sgra zhig gi ngang dga' ldan pho brang du dngos su byon byung ba mjal bas da ni zhing 'dir yun ring mi bzhugs ngo ma la byams pa dngos yin 'dug pa'i da lta mjal rgyu yod dus mjal sar mgyogs par song zhes slob tshogs rnams la bka' phebs pa ltar thams cad ci mgyogs kyis yong bas bsnyun khams ljid skabs khel 'dug rung rgyu mtshan zhus pas zhal mjal tsam byung bas grub thob chen pos don chen po 'grub 'dug ces gsungs byung tshul thugs sras kyi thu bo bka' 'gyur ba bla ma lha rgyal gyi zhal las dngos su thos so// ljags gling rdzong sar ma zhes sngon med gsar rtsom 'di yang deng sang kar rnying kun dang*/

se 'bras dga' gsum/ sa skya gong man dgon khag kun la lugs srol khyab brdal che thang du gyur skad 'dug pa dgongs gzhi dgos pa khyad par can 'phags pa'i spyod yul gyi gnas so// gzhan don du gshegs dgos pa'i dgongs pa ltar bgrang bya so gnyis la gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdu ba'i tshul bstan pa'i de ma thag kun gzigs mkhyen brtse'i mdun du phebs nas da ni 'di phyogs nas 'gro don mi 'ong bas rgya nag gi yul phyogs su gshegs tshul gsungs pa de 'dra la dgongs pa mi gtad pa'i bshol 'debs nan tan zhus pas mthar li thang phyogs nas bskor te yar bzhud yong bas myur du mjal yong zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur ces rje bla ma'i zhal nas dngos su thos zhes zhabs slob rigs kyi zhal nas thos so// khungs btsun gang thos phran bu 'di tsam las rnam thar yi ger bkod pa sogs kyi rtsol ba sus kyang ma mdzad stabs phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rnam thar zhib pa ni gdul bya thun mong ngor snang med du gyur pa ste/ mdor na 'phags bod kyi grub thob chen po sogs dang mnyam nges pa bcas dus phyis bod khams su grub thob kyi spyod pa can 'di 'dra ba 'ga' yang ma byung ba lta bu'o/// / ༈ pad+ma kun bzang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku skye de ma thag pa ni si tu skye phreng bcu gcig pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po zhes da lta 'tsho zhing gzhes pa nyid/ rgyal dbang bco lnga pas tshe ring mched lnga dang zhu ba zhu lan du bgros nas lung bstan tshigs su bcad pa mang po'i don dang mthun par yab yum kyi mtshan dang*/ sa cha yul ris khang khyim sogs sa bkrar bkod pa nas/ 'jam mgon rnam gnyis kyi gzigs pa sngar zhig nas thugs la mnga' ba dang yang dgongs pa gcig mthun gyis li thang gnam chen brag dkar gyi nye 'dabs dang 'brel ba'i yul ljongs su sngags rig 'dzin pa chen po'i rigs rus gtsang mar rab byung bcu drug pa'i nang gses me khyi lor sku 'khrungs pa nges rnyed gyur nas ngos 'dzin mdzad/

karma pa dang gong ma'i phyag phreng sogs so sor ngos 'dzin yid ches su gnang*/ bltams ma thag nas bzung ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad 'phags mthun snang du grub/ chung dus nas chags thogs med pa'i mkhyen pa la mnga' dbang 'byor/ dgung lo bzhi son pas glang lor dpal spungs gdan sar spyan drangs/ rgyal dbang bco lnga pas khri 'don mdzad/ mtshan/ dpal ldan kun khyab nges don smra ba'i seṅge 'chi med pad+ma dbang mchog grub pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde/ zhes pa gsol/ rab tu byung bar mdzad nas/ tshul bstan ljags klog skor tshegs med pa dang*/ yig ris/ sum rtags/ snyan ngag /sgra tsān+ḍa pa sogs rig gnas la brtson pa chen pos sbyangs/ karma pa/ 'jam mgon rin po che/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ mkhan chen bkra shis 'od zer/ bla ma stobs ldan nam thub bstan rgyal mtshan/ ngor dpon slob 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po/ bka' 'gyur ba bla ma btsad po lha rgyal sogs bla ma mang du bsten/ de dag rnams las kaṃ tshang rang lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i bka' brgyud spyi bye brag gi smin grol gyi rim pa dang*/ phyag chen/ chos drug sogs man ngag zab gnad kyi rgyun ci mchis lhag med bzhes pas mtshon ris su ma chad pa'i bstan pa kun la gcig tu gus pas sa dge rnying gsum gyi so so'i bshad sgrub gyi rgyun phal che ba gsan pa sogs ni zhib par gsan yig tu gsal/ dgung lo nyer bzhi'i dus mkhan chen bla ma bkra shis 'od zer mdun nas rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa stabs gcig bzhes/ dge slong gi mtshan/ karma bshad sgrub chos kyi seng ge nges don bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po/ zhes pa gsol/ dgung lo nyer lnga'i dus nas bzung lo bcu phrag lhag tsam bar dpal sprul rin po che'i slob brgyud 'jam pa'i dbyangs gzhan phan chos kyi snang ba'i mdun nas/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs gzhung chen bcu gsum cha lag dang bcas pa/

sgom rim sogs mdo phyogs kyi skor rnams dang*/ rgyud gsang snying sogs sngags gzhung gi skor dang*/ rong zom pa/ klong chen pa'i rdzogs chen skor gyi man ngag zab mo rnams zhib par gsan sbyangs mdzad pas mtshon mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rig gnas dang bcas pa la mkhas pa'i phul du son/ sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i tshul du bzhugs pas btsun pa'i mchog tu gyur/ gdul bya gang la gang 'dul rnams su thabs mkhas thugs rje chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa sogs phan bde khor mo yug tu brdal/ rang gtogs bka' dgon spyi byer rnams la dus gzar ci che'i skabs nyams pa sor chud nyams phan 'tsho skyong*/ ma nyams gong 'phel sogs ci 'gab dang*/ sgrig khrims bca' ba nyams gsos thebs rtsa/ rten bzhag sbyin sgo sogs rgya che mu med dang*/ dbang lung khrid gsum/ so thar sdom 'bog sogs bgrang yas dang*/ gzhan rgya bod 'khrugs zing skabs sogs su rdzogs chen gtsos rnying dgon rigs dang sa dgon sogs la zhabs 'degs phan cha ci drag dang*/ sde dge'i rgyal khab la'ang rang dbang bdag thob yong ba sogs kyi thugs khur lhur bzhes gnang ba sogs bzang po'i phrin las tshad las 'das/ lo re bzhin srog blu brgya phrag mang po/ nyam thag dud 'gro yan byams pas skyong ba sogs snying rje'i mnga' bdag tu gyur/ dus bzang skabs sogs dus rgyun mar me stong dang khri mang po kha yar gang 'gro/ mchod 'bul tshogs gsog rgya gang che/ rdo 'bum shin tu bgrang yas/ rdor sems sgrub mchod tshad ldan gsar 'dzugs/ dgon 'di'i mchod chas skor gser dngul las grub pa spus dag dang*/ tshes bcu chen mo'i yo byad nom ldan rin thang bral ba rnams bzhengs/ spar khang*/ dung 'khor khang*/ khyad par 'du khang chen mo bla brang gong 'og rnams dang bcas pa zhig gsos 'gran bral mthong bas yid 'phrog can rkang nas gsar bzos/ nang rten byams chen gtsos gser zangs las grub pa'i sku brnyan dang mchod rten rigs shin tu che legs grangs mang*/

thub pa dang*/ byams pa'i skyes rabs/ phur pa gtso 'khor bcas pa'i zhal thang dpe bral skor/ mdzod chen rnam lnga'i kha skong dang*/ bstan bcos bka' dang mtshungs rigs spar du brkos pa pusti ka shin tu grangs mang longs pa sogs phyi nang rten bzhengs rigs khor mo yug tu mdzad dang mdzad bzhin pa ste/ dgon 'dir sngar thub chen 'dag bzo tsam las gser zangs las grub pa'i sku brnyan sogs che rigs grangs mang 'ga' yang mi bzhugs pa ltar na/ deng sang rten gsum mang nyung che chung ji bzhugs mchod chas yan bcas phyi bkod nang rten tshang ma skyabs mgon 'di nyid kyi phyag rjes te/ mdor na rnam dkar gyi bya ba rlabs su che ba bsam las 'das pa 'di 'dra ni si tu sku phreng gong ma rim byon rnams la'ang ma byung ba mngon sum ltar ro// phyi dus rgya nag rgyal khab nas kyang skyabs 'jug zhu rgyu yong ba sogs kyis mtshon chos srid gnyis ka'i mkhyen rgya che bas rgya bod phal cher gus 'dud dbang du 'dus shing*/ drag zhan ser skya su yang mjal ma thag tu dad pas yid dga' zhing grol ba dang*/ ci gsung bka' la nyan pa 'ba' zhig tu gyur/ yab sras li thang du phebs skabs smri ti dang lcag sbub zer ba gnyis dme 'khrugs lo mang de phyogs kyi yul khams sdug mnar che ba drung lhan rgyas nas bsdums par mdzad pas dge phan shin tu che bar gyur/ kun gzigs mkhyen brtses kyang khong gi thugs rgyud 'pho ba'i sprul sku yin rgyur 'jam mgon rin po che/ mkhan chen bla ma sogs la zhal bzhes gnang ba dang*/ rten 'brel zhig gi rgyu rkyen las sku bsod dbang thang*/ 'gro don phrin las chen po zhig yong gsungs pa'ang thos/ sprul sku ngos 'dzin dgos rigs 'khrul pa dang bral ba'i ngos 'dzin ngo mtshar ba sha stag dang*/ khyad par rgyal dbang karma pa bcu drug rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje nyid sgrib bral ye shes kyi gzigs par shar ba'i thol byung du ngos 'dzin gnang ba phyis gong ma'i 'da' ka'i zhal chems nye gnas rnams kyis gsang rgyas btab pa dang gung 'grigs te rang gzhan thams cad yid ches ya mtshan gyi gnas su gyur/

skabs su babs pa'i tshe na bza' mtshan gsol dang*/ gdan sar khri 'don legs grub sogs kyi mdzad pa dang 'bad pa brgya phrag bskyangs ba mthar phyin byung ba 'di nyid ni rnam thar rgya mtsho'i snying po lta bu'o// dus phyis dgon 'dir sdom zhib dbye bsal shin tu tshad ldan thog phyin chad gtsang gra'i srol khrigs chags kyi dam rgya rgyun mdzes su bstar ba ni kun la mig ltos yar ldan gyi mdzad pa che shos dang*/ spyir skyabs mgon 'di'i sku ring kar dgon che phra tshang mar 'dul khrims la gces spras gtsor bzung 'khor lo gsum gyi 'dus sde dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel rgyas su byung ba yang mngon sum yongs grags bzhin no// rgyal dbang bco lnga pa dang*/ 'jam mgon bla ma zung nas nges don snying po'i bstan pa gtad/ rgyal dbang bcu drug rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje mchog nas/ rab byung so thar nas bzung*/ kaṃ tshang rang lugs kyi smin grol gyi chos skor ji snyed kyis mtshon sngags mdzod dang gdams mdzod/ sgrub btus sogs shin tu chos bka' rgya chen gsan dang gsan 'gyur bcas/ rigs bdag gtsug gi nor bu gcig pur bkur bar mdzad cing*/ rgyal dbang gong ma nas kyang bka' brgyad dgongs 'dus kyi lung sogs smin grol ci rigs gsan/ spyir bka' brgyud sngags mdzod lan grangs dang*/ dbang lung gsan rigs phal cher skabs skabs 'chad spel gyi chos 'khor rgya che ba bskor bar mdzad pa sogs mdor na bstan 'gror sman pa'i phrin las ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin no// der ma zad mkhan chen bkra shis 'od zer dgongs bzhed nyag gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs gzhan dga' rin po che 'di dgon du gdan zhus yun ring bzhugs 'jags steng rin po ches gsan bsam gong smos ltar dang*/ dbyar gnas su mdo sngags slob grwa'i rgyun gsar 'dzugs bshad sgrub gnyis ka tshang ba'i chos sde chen po'i mtshan gzhi thogs pa'i rgyur ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa bla med du che zhing dar rgyas yun du gnas par smon no// bla ma mang du bzhugs pa'i nang nas yid 'phrog don gyi bla ma ni karma pa bco lnga pa/

'jam mgon rin po che/ mkhan chen bkra shis 'od zer/ gzhan phan chos kyi snang ba rnam pa bzhi po kho na dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dngos 'jam mgon rin po che yin pa 'dra'o// gdod nas sangs rgyas thugs rje yas sprul la sa lam sbyangs ci la dgos kyang*/ tshul bstan tsam du phyag rdzogs chos drug sogs nyams bzhes la dus rtag tu rang bab kyis brtson cing rig pa gcig car ba'i 'gros kyis gnas lugs la rang byan chub pa'i klong chen por g.yo ba med pa mnyam rjes dbyer med du bzhugs par nges kyang dgongs pa rgya mtsho'i 'jing ltar zab pas sus kyang gting mi dpog /yi dam gyi lha gang la mdzad nges tig ma 'tshal yang thun mong tsam du sgrol dkar la mdzad cing ljags bsnyen dung phyur kha longs pa dang*/ so'u mang du skyes pa sogs 'grub rtags kyang ci rigs byung bar mngon/ dag snang mos gus phyogs med du 'byongs pa mthun snang du grub cing*/ rnam kun khyer so gsum gyi rang gshis rnal du rtsol med 'byor bzhin bzhugs/ lhag par rang bzhin shugs 'byung dang*/ dgos pa'i dus su gsung zur phebs pa sogs dang dpag dus gsum sa ler mkhyen par gdon mi za ba'i mtshan ma ni rang gzhan kun gyi snang ngor skabs 'gar mngon sum gsal/ 'on kyang zhal gzigs lung bstan/ mngon shes nyams snang sogs la thugs dgyes tshor cher mi mdzad/ rtsing spyod mkhan rnams rtag tu dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan/ 'dod chung chog shes/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ thos bsam sgom gsum dang ldan pa'i gang zag chos la spyod pa rnams dang len gong bkur dpe med gnang*/ gzhan du ma ro gcig la mnga' dbang 'byor pa'i rtags/ 'di phyogs dang*/ rdza rgyud byang kha sogs su zhabs rjes bzhag pa mang zhing*/ sa stag lor yab sras lhan rgyas li thang 'dab smad du phebs pa na spang phug dgon gyi gtsug lag khang mdun rgyab nye logs sogs la karma pa gzhon nu'i zhabs rjes mang tsam/

rin po che'i zhabs rjes gsal bar kha shas/ lhag par si tu rin po che nyid kyi chib pa thang smug gi rjes 'dam nang brdzis pa lta bu drug bdun tsam 'cham sar rdo gcal steng du zab la gsal ba bzhag 'dug pa der yod kun gyi mig gi spyod yul du gyur/ sngar byes phebs zhig gi skabs sga stod nas phebs lam 'bri chu la lha dar zhag gcig tsam glo bur chags/ dbu che nas rab gnas kyi me tog 'thor ba dpe war 'bal mo nang gi gzhi bdag gi ri mgor zang thal du song ba mngon sum dang*/ rgyal dbang chib skyel bod phebs skabs hor sog sde dang 'brang sde gnyis sha 'khon thug sgo che ba'i 'brang stod dpon nas skyabs 'jug zhus pa gsol ka dang dgra chos rgyas pa tshar gcig gsungs pas de rjes sog sde'i dmag rgyus yod kyis 'brang dpon gyi dgun ru sdod bzhin pa'i sa char babs kyang dpon gyi sbra dang ru 'khor bcas gtan nas ma mthong zhing lung stong zhig tu mthong nas phyir log song ba yin zhes sog sde'i dmag 'gro mkhan rnams kyi kha nas yongs grags lab pa dang*/ 'brang dpon nas kyang lung pa'i ri dwags rnams su bskor nyul byas nas rang bzhin gyis phyir thegs song zhes dngos su bshad rgyu 'dug pa sogs 'di 'dra'i rigs shin tu ches mang ste bri ba la dgos pa cher mi 'dug /gnas gzigs phebs skabs gtsang 'brug ra lung dgon du gling rje ras pa'i 'dra zhal gsung byon ma de'i zhal ngo tshon dkar po byugs pa can zhig red 'dug nan tan gsungs kyang yang yang bltas pas dngos gnas gser chab gsol ba zhig yin 'dug go/ nad pa tshab chen rigs bka' bsgo byin rlabs dang thugs gtad tsam gyis 'joms pa/ phyag mdud lus la 'chang ba 'ga' zhig pha rol gyi mtshon gyis mi tshugs pa/ gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa sogs dngos mthong re dang*/ khang pa me shor ba so so'i khungs su dad rten chags l+h+wam dang*/

chos gos gnang ba yod pa 'ga' zhig la me dreg tsam yang gos mi 'dug tshul ljongs phyogs phyogs 'ga' nas bshad rgyu'ang 'dug /'brang sras bla ma blo gros rab gsal dus rgyun nad gdon gyis mnar ba la gu gul la ljags sngags shig mdzad nas rgyun du bdug rgyu gnang ba'i nang phyis su ring bsrel dkar po brgya phrag sogs grangs mang 'khrungs 'dug pa bdag gis kyang dngos mthong byung ba sogs mtha' yas so// slob ma'i gtso bo ni rgyal dbang bcu drug pa/ dpa' bo rin po che/ tre bo zhabs drung*/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa/ zur mang bstan sprul/ 'dir dgon gyi sku mched rnams sogs kyis gtsos bka' brgyud pa'i bla sprul phal che ba rnams so// skyabs mgon 'di nyid kyi rnam thar cung zhib rgyas ni slob ma'i thu bo mkhas btsun grub pa'i bdag nyid can gyis rtsom par gnang 'gyur ltar las ma mchis shing*/ 'dir dpal spungs dgon gyi gdan rabs kyi rnam thar skra rtse tsam bka' 'bum dkar chags kyi khogs dbub lta bur bris pa yin la/ yang snying si tu'i sku phreng rnams ni byams pa mgon po dang*/ o rgyan rin po che zung du 'jug pa'i rnam 'phrul sha stag pa ste/ ma 'ongs rnam 'dren lnga par 'tshang rgya rgyur mgrin gcig lung nas gsal ba bcas sangs rgyas dngos su grub pa la rmongs pas don mi 'gyur pa'i gya tshom gyi tshig ris mang po bri ba ni sgro skur gyi gzhi dang yon tan bslad pa'i skyon du 'gyur nyen che bas 'brel yod med ni ci cha ste spyir 'thad pa dang bral lo snyam mo/// / ༈ dmigs bsal skabs don ngo ma/ rje bdag nyid chen po mchog 'di gsung rtsom chog bsgrigs sogs sngar yod las gsar spros rigs la thugs dgyes tshor cher med tshul gsungs pa ltar yang*/ rgyal dbang rin po ches gtsos slob ma rnams dang*/ gzhan mchog phal gyi gdul bya rnams kyis nan tan du gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/

sgrub dkyil dang chog bsgrigs/ dbang chog mtshams sbyor bcas dang*/ zhal gdams gsol 'debs/ mchod chog /smon lam/ zin bris kyi rim pa ji snyed sogs dang*/ khyad par o rgyan rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i sgrub thabs 'di dgongs gter byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ches khyad 'phags dang ldan pa yin zhes 'jam mgon rin po ches zhal gyis bzhes pa bcas gang cir bris ma glegs bam gsum tsam bzhugs pa 'di rigs nyer mkho shin tu che ba med na thabs chag lta bu mang bar ma zad/ mdzod lnga'i shing rta pad+ma'i rgyal tshab rje rang gi thugs kyi sras gcig rgyal bas lung bstan 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che la ljags lung gdams gtad dang*/ de rjes ye shes kyi skus kyang lan gcig bskyar gnang nye brgyud kyi byin rlabs ngo mtshar ba dang*/ gzhan la'ang 'chad spel dgos pa'i bka' lung bcas ched du bstsal 'dug pa sogs byin rlabs kyi ngad ma yal ba'i lung rgyun khyad 'phags da lta bzhugs bzhin pa sogs sgo gang thad nas spar du bskrun pa'i thugs rtsol zhig bka' drin ma chung zhes mkhas btsun bzang gsum sogs dam pa'i tshul dgus phyug pa zur mang bstan 'dzin sprul sku mchog nas gsol ba btab pa thugs la bzhag pa dang 'brel sgrub brgyud bstan pa rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag kun gzigs byams mgon rin po che si tu sku phreng bcu gcig pa/ karma pa dang*/ 'jam mgon bla ma zung gi lung don dang mthun pa'i mtshan bsdus pa yongs grags su pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po zhes gsol ba'i pad+ma'i ljags ldan gsum pas chos sbyin gyi phyi mor rab byung bcu drug pa'i nang gses sa yos lo nas 'go brtsams/ bris rkos mi mgo brgyad dgu re la lag brkos su brko bcol rgyu mdzad pa 'di lo khyu mchog ces pa lcags sbrul ston ka'i lang tsho dar la babs pa'i skabs su zhu dag brko btsugs bcas mthar phyin par grub pa yin no// gzhi nas bka' 'bum ched du bsgrig rgyu'i thugs gnyer yod ma 'dra ba dang*/

nyer mkho che rigs rnams 'thor 'khyar du song ba yin snyam bcas da dung 'di nang gsung yongs rdzogs ma tshang ba mang tshan yod nges te/ ma dpe bris ma'i ka tho nang du'ang ma 'khod pa dngos mthong mang zhing*/ 'khod rigs gras nas zhwa nag rtogs brjod dang*/ dbang bskur gyi dge bskul/ tshe ring ma'i g.yang skyabs sogs mkho khyad che ba can 'ga' dang 'ga' zhig kyang phyis su dpe gras su ma bzhugs pa sogs kyis mtshon/ slad nas gsung tshogs ngo ma rigs phyogs gang nas gal srid shugs 'byung dang rtsol ba zung du 'jug pas nges rnyed lta bu byung tshe rim par kha skong du 'jog 'os shin tu che ba'ang zhar byung gi 'phros pa'o// de ltar rnam par dkar ba'i legs byas rab tu bsgrubs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba zla ba bdud rtsi lta bu ci mchis pa thams cad kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub snying por yongs su smin pa'i rim pa ni dmigs med thugs rje chen po'i klong nas kun mkhyen byams mgon rin po che mchog gis 'khor gsum rnyog bral gyi rang bzhin du bsngo ba'i dgongs gtad rtsol med lhun gyis grub par gnang ba gor ma chag pa ltar las gzhan du spros 'os ma mchis so/// / ༈ da ni dkar chag gi rim pa dngos 'god pa la/ mdo rji oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang 'brel ba'i pod gsum du bsgrigs pa ste/ dang por/ oṃ/ pod la/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor spyi dang bye brag rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa ye shes bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod la ldeb/ 94 gu ru dharma rā dza'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams dbyangs mchod sprin rab 'byams kyi glu zhes bya ba la ldeb/ 2 bde chen zhing gi sgrub pa lha dang bla ma dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor rta mchog ba la ha la ldeb/ 7 o rgyan rin po che bde gshegs spyi dril du bsgrubs pa'i rnal 'byor grub gnyis nor bu'i char 'bebs la ldeb/ 14 o rgyan rin po che rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i las byang dngos grub sprin phreng byin rlabs char 'bebs la ldeb/

8 rgyun khyer gyi rim pa phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa dngos grub bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod la ldeb/ 15 gso sbyong rgyun khyer ldeb/ 2 ma hā mā ya'i tshogs mchod 'dod rgu myur ster la ldeb/ 4 gsol 'debs kyi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod la ldeb/ 53 thun min zhal gdams kyi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa nges don bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod la ldeb/ 33 dbang bshad kyi skor phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa ngo mtshar bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod la ldeb/ 35 bde mchog lha lnga'i sgo nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i rim pa zab mo'i sgo 'byed la ldeb/ 22 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur ye shes myur 'bebs la ldeb/ 25 bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phag mo'i mngon dkyil gsang chen myur lam dang dbang bskur bde chen lam gyi snang byed sbrel ma la ldeb/ 31 kun rig dbang bskur rnam grol sgo chen 'byed pa'i lde'u mig la ldeb/ 15 rje mkha' spyod dbang pos mdzad pa'i ma mgon zhal sbyor gyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs rgyan dbang dang bcas pa'i yig sna gnyis gab sprad 'khrugs bsal bltas chog tu bkod pa la ldeb/ 39 bcas/// / ༈ gnyis pa/ āḥ pod la/ tshe dpag lha dgu'i dkyil chog smin dbang rab gsal snang ba'i nyin byed la ldeb/ 21 'phags sgrol bkra shis don 'grub ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa la ldeb/ 26 sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa grub gnyis mchog stsol la ldeb/ 20 'phags ma sgrol ma nyer gcig gi cho ga dbang chog dang bcas pa me tog pad dkar phreng ba la ldeb/ 36 sgrol ma'i rnam bshad gsal pa'i 'od zer sngar yod ldeb/ 7 gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma'i mchod chog yid bzhin re skong nor bu'i gru char la ldeb/ 18 rtsa gsum dril sgrub tshe g.yang 'gugs pa'i rim pa 'dod rgu'i bum bzang la ldeb/
